exposure: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) phenotypes (HA+PCO, M+PCO, HA+M+PCO)
cohort: 41 pregnant women with PCOS and 49 healthy pregnant women
finding: Women with PCOS, particularly those with the HA+M+PCO phenotype, had significantly higher rates of pre-eclampsia, gestational diabetes, and lower birth weight babies compared to healthy women.
